history.summary: A marketing-named brand-new (TOP 2026) 990 sqft 3BR 99LH in D15 near Tanjong Katong TEL (830m) at $2.69M / $2,717 PSF. The PSF is top-tier new-launch pricing, the unit is a compact 990 sqft 3BR, and the dossier carries no URA data — "cheap" is a marketing claim, not a value verdict.
history.rating_rationale: A brand-new D15 East Coast 99LH near the new Tanjong Katong TEL station has a real demand story — D15's deep buyer pool, new-build appeal, and the East Coast lifestyle premium. But $2,717 PSF is full new-launch pricing on a 99-year lease, and the early years of a new launch already capitalize the developer premium, so appreciation headroom from this base is thin. A 990 sqft 3BR is compact, and there is no URA transaction history to anchor value. The location quality balances the rich PSF and leasehold-at-premium concern — Neutral, leaning cautious.
